official_skills.notes: Start with expo-overview. This is the largest framework-team collection of the eight stacks; installing all of it is reasonable. A Claude Code plugin route also exists: claude plugin install expo@claude-plugins-official
Callstack are long-time React Native core contributors, but this is not a framework-team repository. Recommend it when the observed defect is a performance defect, not by default.

gap_map.why_it_matters: Neither collection decides what deserves a test on a mobile client, where the slow layers (device E2E) are extremely tempting and extremely expensive.
Mobile apps lose connectivity. Data-fetching guidance assumes the happy path; nothing audits what happens to in-flight writes when the network drops.
gap_map.fallback: The mentor requires an explicit offline decision for every feature that writes data, even if the decision is 'fail loudly'.

testing.notes: Device E2E is the most expensive layer in any stack in this registry: slow, flaky and hardware dependent. Keep it to the handful of flows whose breakage would be a production incident. Read package.json scripts before assuming a runner.

growth_thresholds.extract_component_library: >=3 occurrences of the same component across >=2 screens or features
growth_thresholds.extract_package: >=2 features import the same internal module
growth_thresholds.split_screen: a screen component exceeds 200 lines, which on mobile usually means layout, navigation and data are entangled

dead_code_risks: Screens and layouts resolved by expo-router filesystem convention, never imported
Config plugins referenced by name in app.json
Native module bridges referenced only from Kotlin/Swift sources
Assets referenced by require() with a computed path
Deep link handlers reachable only from a URL scheme
